- The combined “Brick” and “Give Way” sign near the bus station in Pripyat has been corrected. "Brick" has been removed

- Fixed the problem with the cursor disappearing when exiting the menu from a cutscene

- Fixed a bug related to the cameraman in the "Speed" scenario
- Fixed a bug due to which pedestrians in Southern China walked together in large groups

- Adjusted appearance of the HB-235 bus in the garage
- Fixed a bug with the language selection scrollbar in the options menu

- Improved visibility of parking lights of a police minibus in Pripyat

notes.title: The update is available, featuring fixes for steering wheels and controllers!
notes.content:
We just published another patch for the game. It affects controls, when several controllers are connected at once.

Before, buttons of controllers were read from each controller separately, unlike axles. Because of that, axles’ values could be recognized incorrectly. Now the game can distinguish the axles of the first 4 connected controllers.

But Unity Engine, which the game is built on, can’t guarantee that the controllers will be detected in the exact same order as the previous time. Each new connected controller will be detected as a new one. Probably, we’ll solve this problem a bit later.

You can read more about setting up controllers here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2883063682

notes.title: We wish you merry Christmas and happy New Year!
notes.content:
Our team wishes you merry Christmas and happy New Year!

2021 was an important year for both our team and bus simulators we've been working on all this time.

Bus Driver Simulator has received 15 updates during 2021, both small and big ones. For example, in the beginning of the year we released five unique and interesting scenarios for Murom Suburbs DLC: driving with potato bags in passenger compartment and creating New Year mood in the corresponding scenario. In Summer, we released the new map called Russian Soul, which was highly rated by players (its rating in Steam is now over 80%). The most noticeable update of this Fall is support for Steam Workshop with custom liveries. Finally, we released Bus Driver Simulator: Countryside on PS4 and Xbox One.

Another bus simulator Bus World has made even more progress. Despite the fact that it's in development for 2 and a half years, it began to look playable only this year. We finished many systems and components we've been working on since previous year and fully changed rendering pipeline to HDRP. We learned and implemented dozens of new methods and workarounds to improve performance, which was very bad just after we moved to HDRP. And, gameplay started to feel really nice when we added scenarios with unusual conditions such as tsunami or tornado.

Now we can easily state that Bus World is on the polishing stage. We're fixing bugs, making the balance better, finishing scenarios, adding various details and working on making performance even better. Of course, we've still got a lot to do, but our test builds are already playable, and the game is moving to its release version step by step.

Of course, we have huge plans for 2022: we're planning to release Bus World and provide it with updates for the whole year.

We wish you to take a good rest on these holidays and have only good events in 2022!

notes.title: Announcing our new game - Fly Corp!
notes.content:
We present you our new game, [b]Fly Corp[/b], for PCs and mobile devices! It is a minimalistic transport strategy about [b]planes[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/3bd3b7a6b8e92280701377f7bda384c4d95ce01c.png[/img]

The game is being actively developed, but you can [b]try[/b] the demo version for PCs right now [b]for free[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372530

Despite the quite minimalistic look of the game, we've been doing our best to make the gameplay deep and involving while keeping the controls simple and easy to use.

[h3]So, what this game is?[/h3]
You're about to develop your own airline transport network in various cities and countries by creating routes, buying new planes, upgrading airports and airplanes. The game features an advanced passenger flow system. All cities are real, and their population corresponds with reality. The more the population is, the higher is the number of people who want to fly somewhere. Every passenger has their destination point and, if no direct route is available, he would fly with changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/401d8e5539630b4f955a2ae2812eaca48c3c0600.png[/img]

There are [b]several game modes[/b] now.
Your task in [i][b]Unlock all Countries[/b][/i] mode is to unlock all the countries of the world by buying them for in-game money and to cover the whole planet with your network. You'll have to unlock a new country every 6 minutes in order not to loose. In [i][b]Challenges[/b][/i] mode, different scenarios with pre-set conditions and targets are waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/c2506b1ecb1f208a81556ba59cee3bc344109d0e.jpg[/img]

[b]Try[/b] the demo on Steam [b]for free[/b] right now! Also, don't forget to add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] on Steam and join our social network groups so that you won't miss any news!

[b]Our group on Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/KishMishGames/

The full version is planned to be released in a few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/d4d9f311646a1e1ebbd18d9e30895800a29839f7.png[/img]

[b]P.S.[/b] The work on Bus Driver Simulator, Bus World and Metro Simulator has been going as it did before. Fly Corp is worked on by a small separate mini-department, which is not connected to simulation games. It means that you don't need to care about updates of your favorite games - they will release just like usual, and Fly Corp development isn't a problem for that.

notes.title: In development: stelae and bus stops
notes.content:
[h3]In the game you will see stelae like this.[/h3]
The first one is called "Torch". It told you that you're approaching Chernobyl Nuclear Plant. It is known as one of the most polluted zones after the disaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/d308d6237757a13b6307f3c46cd018420957b86a.jpg[/img]

It's located in the infamous Red Forest (by the way, in Bus World it will be in two versions: before and after the disaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/331d031239facc90de4ed32f588ef8ad66949b5a.jpg[/img]

The second one is informing you that you're entering Chernobyl. The Chernobyl Bus Terminal will be the southern end of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/0734577766b9881a5df7de6eb02bb4c518c91f59.jpg[/img]

Finally, here you can take a look at the bus stop. Soviet stops were designed much more interesting than modern ones. Just look at that mosaic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36189081/dcb98e371e53e62fedcbba4d4c0e0803f5987c12.jpg[/img]
